instructions:
GPTMaker API — manage AI agents, channels, chats, contacts, trainings, intentions, transfer rules, idle actions, custom fields, interactions, and MCP connections.

Available tool groups:
- workspace: list workspaces, get credits
- agents: CRUD, settings, webhooks, activate/deactivate, chat, credits, behavior history
- trainings: create/list/update/delete text, website, video, document trainings
- channels: create/list/update/delete channels, QR code, widget, config, conversations
- chats: list chats and messages, send messages, human support handoff
- contacts: search, get, update contacts
- custom_fields: CRUD for workspace custom fields
- idle_actions: configure automatic idle message sequences
- intentions: configure webhook triggers for agents
- transfer_rules: configure conversation transfer conditions
- interactions: list/delete completed interactions, export to CSV
- mcp_connections: add/manage MCP server connections for agents

Auth: set GPTMAKER_API_TOKEN environment variable.
